content.content: 1. License: no element of the dependent contradicts the prerequisite. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element. 2. The source follows the read and the two: the set is drawn from jj's change report (M-jj), the ids it holds are change ids each owning a `nodes/<id>.json` document (D1b, S2-path), and that is the source S2-read reads from. Fail if the claim falls back to the working copy's directory, admits an id that owns no document, or drops one that does — name it.
content.rationale: The jj-sourced set is where the enumeration meets the change listing, the owning-change identity, the one layout and the read it must agree with; the gate forces the set to answer to all of them without re-deciding the query or how a document is read.
